item.title: Interference-Enhanced Large Electron--Phonon Coupling from Raman-active Breathing Modes in Moiré Semiconductors
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Yang Zhang, Ning Mao, Shaozheng Wang, Xumin Chang, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi 等9位作者
Superconductivity was recently observed in twisted WSe₂ and MoTe₂, raising a central question: is the pairing driven by electronic correlations, by phonons, or by both? Answering it requires determining the electron--phonon coupling (EPC) in these moiré semiconductors, whose calculation in realistic supercells of thousands of atoms lies beyond the reach of direct first-principles methods. Here we combine filling-dependent Raman spectroscopy with machine-learning first-principles calculations to obtain the EPC mode by mode in supercells of up to tens of thousands of atoms. item.title: 更真实的固态模型使量子自旋液体中的分形子更接近实验探测
item.description:
📚 Physics News
该报道介绍了分形子这一类奇异准粒子：它们可出现在不同自旋有序之间的磁畴壁顶点处，具有近乎不可移动的受限动力学特征。由于单个分形子难以独立位移、通常只能通过其他分形子协同移动，这种有限运动性被认为有望用于更稳健的量子信息存储。文章强调，采用更贴近真实固体的模型可能提高在量子自旋液体中探测分形子的可行性。

item.title: Plasma screening of atomic energy levels to ten billion atmospheres
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Gilbert Collins, David Bishel, Philip Nilson, David Chin, E. Smith, J. Ruby 等13位作者
At atmospheric pressures the atom is typically considered immutable with known energy levels for electrons; however, in the deep interiors of stars where atoms exist at and beyond the atomic unit of pressure, i.e. hundreds of millions to billions of atmospheres pressure, the atom is fundamentally changed. At such conditions, unbound electrons are squeezed interior to core orbitals of the atom, screening the nuclear charge and dramatically shifting the quantum energy levels for electrons. The plasma becomes integral to the structure and properties of the atom, a regime that is challenging for today’s theoretical tools and where benchmark data are needed. item.title: Wider Winter Temperature Variability Fuels Stronger Spring Dust Storms
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Yuzhi Liu, weiqi tang, Linxia Wang, Ying Wang, Yangyang Huang, Jie Gao 等7位作者
Dust storms are a fundamental Earth system process, influencing global climate, biogeochemical cycles, and human health. However, how a changing climate reshapes their activity remains largely uncertain. Here we show that while externally forced long-term warming tends to suppress the global frequency of dust storms, increased internal climate variability, manifesting as greater temperature fluctuations, paradoxically enhances the spring dust storm intensity. Simply put, the greater the temperature variability during the preceding winter, the stronger the ensuing spring dust storm activity. item.title: Living deep reservoir computing by microfluidic axon routing
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Ke Wang, Wanqi Dai, Yawen Li, Zhuo Han, Jinshuai Du, Yin Deng 等12位作者
This study develops and implements living deep reservoir computing based on a multistage microfluidic chip featuring unidirectional axon-routing channels for the regulation of directed in vitro axonal growth. To elucidate the specific contribution of unidirectional axon routing to the performance of living deep reservoir computing systems, a topology-matched living non-deep reservoir with bidirectional straight channels was fabricated as the control group.
